risks.title: Significant Overstock Risk on T-Shirts
risks.description: Historical event data shows actual attendee pick-up rates of 65-70% for apparel items. Current order quantity of 2,000 t-shirts for projected 1,200 attendees creates high dead stock exposure.
risks.impact: Potential waste of $4,250-5,950 in unsold inventory

risks.title: Event Deadline Risk - Water Bottles
risks.description: Lead time of 35 days for water bottles leaves only 5 days of buffer before event date (May 15). Current supplier (SUP-METAL-08) has 78% on-time delivery rate.
risks.impact: 22% probability of late delivery impacting event readiness

risks.title: Better Supplier Alternative Available
risks.description: Alternative supplier SUP-TECH-18 offers 15% cost savings on USB drives with equivalent quality score (4.2 vs 4.1) and better on-time delivery (92% vs 85%).
risks.impact: Potential savings of $1,170 with improved delivery reliability

risks.title: Badge Holder Over-Ordering Pattern
risks.description: Analysis of 8 similar tech events shows average usage of 85% of registered attendees for badge holders. Current quantity assumes 100% pick-up.

recommendations.title: Reduce T-Shirt Quantity to Match Historical Pick-Up Rates
recommendations.description: Adjust t-shirt order from 2,000 to 1,400 units based on 70% historical attendee pick-up rate for 1,200 projected attendees.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduce dead stock risk by $5,100 while maintaining adequate buffer
actionItems: Revise line item CAT-2026-1001 quantity to 1,400 units
Document assumption: 70% pick-up rate based on historical events
Plan for on-demand reorder if pick-up exceeds 75%

recommendations.title: Expedite Water Bottle Production or Switch Supplier
recommendations.description: Either request expedited production from current supplier or switch to SUP-METAL-11 with 18-day lead time and 94% on-time delivery.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduce event delivery risk from 22% to <5%
actionItems: If expedite not available, switch to SUP-METAL-11
Add 10% rush fee to budget if staying with current supplier

recommendations.title: Switch USB Drive Supplier for Cost and Reliability
recommendations.description: Migrate USB drive order from SUP-TECH-22 to SUP-TECH-18 for better pricing and delivery performance.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Save $1,170 (15%) and improve on-time delivery probability by 7%
actionItems: Update purchase order to reference new supplier

recommendations.title: Adjust Badge Holder Quantity to Realistic Usage
recommendations.description: Reduce badge holder order to 2,125 (85% of 2,500 registered) to align with historical usage patterns.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduce overstock waste by $560 with minimal service risk
actionItems: Arrange for emergency reprint capability if needed
Monitor registration trends 2 weeks before event
